job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, and deploy large language models using Generative AI techniques to solve complex business problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems and processes.
Develop and maintain high-quality code for retrieval augmented generation models, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
Conduct research on emerging trends in Large Language Modeling (LLM) to stay up-to-date with industry advancements.

Job Requirements :

6-11 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence Engineering or related field.
Strong expertise in Generative AI, particularly in LLMs.
Proficiency in developing scalable software applications using various programming languages such as Python or Java.
